It has no tail.\n- **Layout:** the two primers sit back-to-back with their 5' ends adjacent, as the Q5 site-directed mutagenesis kit expects. PCR around the whole plasmid then gives a linear product containing the insertion. The kit's KLD step circularizes it.\n\n**Melting temperatures (annealing portions only):** these are my own figures.
